selection_rule: four Claude agents, about 34 items each in item-id order, from the question stems only: no options, no gold, no strata, no MC-100 file

roles.topical: up to 3 per item: documents that govern the question's subject, preferring the version in force
roles.predecessor: for a topical document, the instrument it replaced or amends, when the site carries it
roles.distractor: up to 5 per batch: documents of the same fields that govern other matters
